First, note that Europe/London in 1029 did not have modern time zones or daylight saving time. Historically, local mean time based on longitude was used. London is at approximately 0° longitude (Greenwich), so its local mean time is essentially UTC (GMT).  

Thus, 1 AM February 16, 1029 in London local mean time = 1 AM February 16, 1029 in UTC.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 01:00
